jobs.occupation: Blomsterbinder/-Dekoratør/Florist
jobs.description:
Er du træt af butik åbningstider med weekend arbejde, som blomsterbinder/blomsterdekotatør hos os arbejde du indenfor normale kontortider mandag til fredag.

Vi søger 1 ny kollega til vores team af florister.

Så vil du med på vores spændende rejse, hvor du arbejder fra vores nye flotte binderi i Søften ved Aarhus. 

God timeløn og du bestemmer selv dine arbejdstider, også hvis du ønsker forskellig timetal uge for uge. 

Samtidig binder vi i letter materialer, så du ikke belaster dine skulder og arme så meget. 

Vi går meget op i et godt arbejdsmiljø, så du står på absoberende måtter, har hæve/sænke arbejdsbord, og du får arbejdestøj og det bedste i værktøj.  

Vores indeklima er ikke vådt og fugtigt som du kender det fra trationelle blomsterbutikker. 

Jobbet går ud på at binde bæredygtige blomsterbuketter, som vi sælger på vores webshop og via design, indretning, brugskunst og møbelbutikker. Vi sælger i både Danmark, Sverige, Norge og Tyskland.

I vores koncept køre vi med flere forskellig buketter design i 3 størrelser. Det er disse buketter man skal binde, man arbejder i vores binderi og står sammen med søde kollegaer.

Tjek vores hjemmeside www.livingflowers.dk for lidt mere info om vores bæredygtige koncept og for at se vores buketter.

Udover buketter levere vi også mere og mere til Hoteller og restauranter, hvor vi laver speciel designs, som tilpasses kundes behov. Så ønsker du yderlig udfordring, så er der muligheder hos disse kunder. 

Det er et krav at du er blomsterbinder, blomsterdekoratør uddandelsen eller minimum har arbejdet fuldtid i nogle år som blomsterbinder.  

Vi læser ansøgningerne løbende når de kommer ind og indkalder også løbende til samtaler, så sende endlig din ansøgning med det samme.

 

ENGLISH VERSION: 

We are looking for full-time florist, we are very flexible with come and go times, we will find the best working hours for you. As we are not a store, we do not work in the weekends. 

We are located in Søften (Aarhus), and the job is to tie sustainable flower bouquets, which we sell on our webshop and via shops around Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Germany.

See more about us at : www.livingflowers.dk

It is a requirement to have a florist education or have worked with binding flowers full time for minimum 3 years.

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Development of High Temperature Heat Pumps with Thermal Energy Storage - DTU Construct
jobs.description:
Do you want to start your research career by making industrial heat clean, flexible and affordable? At DTU Construct you will work at the forefront of technologies key to decarbonizing industries: high-temperature heat pumps and high-temperature thermal energy storage.We invite applications for a fully funded PhD position in the Thermal Energy Section of the Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at the Technical University of Denmark. The position is part of HeatMinds, a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network funded by Horizon Europe. HeatMinds brings together 6 universities and research institutes and 12 industrial and research partners across Europe to develop industrial high-temperature heat pumps and thermal energy storage. Your project will develop new Carnot Battery technologies: systems that combine heat pumps based on high temperature thermodynamic cycles together with high-temperature thermal energy storage, such as molten salts and dual-media packed beds. These systems will deliver clean process heat while also giving industry flexibility on the electricity market.Supervision: Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson with industrial secondments. Responsibilities and qualificationsYour overall goal will be to find out how industrial high temperature heat pumps can benefit from integrated thermal energy storage by developing new cost-effective, high-performance hybrid configurations. You will work with fellow doctoral candidates across the network and with industrial partners in Denmark and abroad.Your main tasks will be:
• Develop and Design new architectures comprising cycles using natural working fluids and thermal energy storage, optimised for efficiency, cost, and fast response to electricity price signals
• Carry out multi-objective optimisation and dynamic system analysis of alternative layouts
• Validate results by carrying out experiments and data comparison during industrial secondments, turning the results into innovations with real-world impact (e.g. patents, future commercial solutions) 
• Publish in international journals, present at conferences and take part in HeatMinds network training, summer schools and outreach.You have:
• A solid background in engineering thermodynamics, heat transfer and energy technologies, e.g. conversion or storage systems 
• Familiarity with modelling and numerical simulations, for example for MSc thesis or student projects 
• Programming skills, preferably in Python, Matlab, Modelica or similar 
• Excellent written and spoken English, and the motivation to work in an international, goal-oriented environment.MSCA eligibility: at the time of recruitment, you must not already hold a doctoral degree. You must also not have resided or carried out your main activities (work, studies, etc) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before your recruitment date.You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.Approval and Enrolment The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. We offerDTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.Salary and appointment termsThe appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. The PhD salary will be based on the Marie S. Curie compensation scheme conditions and according to the grant agreement. Based on seniority the candidate will receive a minimum of DKK 30.264,08 (base salary) and DKK 1580,90 (PhD supplement). In addition, DTU will also pay pension consisting of 18,07%. Finally, it is possible to apply for family allowance. The period of employment is 3 years. The position is a full-time position. Starting date is anticipated as 1 April 2027, or according to mutual agreement. You can read more about career paths at DTU here.Further informationFurther information may be obtained from Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli, adrsc@dtu.dk and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson, acerl@dtu.dk. You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk. If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. Application procedure Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 24 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• A copy of thesis (if available) or other publications (if available)
• A short critical literature review (max. 3 pages) on high-temperature heat pumps combined with thermal energy storage (e.g. Carnot Batteries): select up to 5 relevant publications and explain your choice, compare their methods & findings, identify possible open research questions, explaining how your background would help you address them. Include at least one figure or table of your own making.You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse workers for Black Friday
jobs.description:
Do you envision yourself as part of the daily operations in a large warehouse, and do you thrive working independently and in a structured and high paced manner? Then you might be the one we're looking for. On behalf of DSV, Randstad is seeking warehouse workers for the upcoming Black Friday high season, where the primary tasks consist of picking, packing and scanning various products. 

As a warehouse worker at DSV, you will have a great deal of responsibility for your own tasks and for ensuring that your work is of good quality. You are able to work independently and are encouraged to take initiative, as you become a part of a fast-paced working environment. It is also important that you bring a positive energy to the team and that you want to work in close cooperation with your colleagues.

Working tasks includes:

• Handling labels

• Driving various stablers, runners, stackers etc.

• Picking and packing

• Utilizing a scanner

• Receiving goods

• Driving and replenishment of pallets, orders, packages etc.

The job can be physically requiring at times as the picking is manual, and the tempo is high.

We expect that you:

• Have experience with similar positions in previous jobs - especially driving stablers

• Are highly motivated to contribute

• Respect the operations and procedures

• You can communicate in English

• You can work independently and in a structured manner

• You are detail-oriented

• It is an advantage if you have experience using handheld scanners and picking by autostore 

Important information about the position:

• This recruitment is specifically for our Black Friday peak season. You must be available for overtime, particularly on  Sundays. During the busiest period (one week before Black Friday, Black Friday week, and one week after Black Friday), candidates are expected to be available to work on Saturdays as well as Sundays. 

• Due to the busy Black Friday period, you must not have any planned holidays or vacation during the contract period. Any time off must be approved prior to starting. Vacation requests submitted after hire will not be approved. 

• Temporary position running from week 45 (startup November 2nd–4th) until just before Christmas. 

• Your onboarding meeting will take place on your first day of work. For morning shifts, onboarding is at 08:00. For evening shifts, onboarding will take place at 14:00. Onboarding is mandatory.

• Salary: 156.50 DKK/hour for Reach Truck Operators and 143.40 DKK/hour for all other profiles. 

• Safety shoes are required.

Open positions, shifts and starts dates:

• Morning shift (06:00 - 14:00): Looking for 6 candidates (2 AutoStore pick/pack, 1 experienced reach truck operator, 1 gift wrapping, 2 manual pack/sort). Start date: 3–4 candidates on Monday 02/11 or Tuesday 03/11. 

• Evening shift (14:00 - 22:00): Looking for 9 candidates (4 AutoStore pick/pack, 1 experienced reach truck operator, 1 gift wrapping, 3 manual pack/sort). Start date: 4–5 candidates on Monday 02/11 or Tuesday 03/11. 

• E-commerce department - Day shifts: Looking for 5 candidates (Foret 06:00-14:00: 1 pick/pack; Smartbox 08:00-16:00: 1 pick/pack; Babysam 09:00-17:00: 1 low-level picker & 1 manual pick/pack). Start date: All 5 candidates start on Wednesday 04/11. 

Application and contact:

If you want to know more about the position please contact consultant Liv Nielsen on email liv.nielsen@randstad.dk. All inquiries will be handled confidentially.

About Randstad

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Specialist  Reblade ApS — Careers
jobs.description:
Supply Chain Specialist

Mørke, Denmark

About Reblade:

Reblade is a Danish technology company founded in 2020, developing autonomous drone-

based robotic systems for leading edge repair of wind turbine blades.

We design, develop, manufacture and test our own technology, combining mechanical

engineering, electronics, software and robotics.

Our international team works in English, and we collaborate with major wind energy

operators, universities and technology partners across Europe.

We are strengthening our supply chain and purchasing capabilities.

About the position:

We are looking for a Supply Chain Specialist to take responsibility for purchasing, supplier

management, inventory coordination and procurement cost control.

You will work closely with our engineering, production and finance teams to ensure that

components and materials are available when needed, suppliers meet our requirements, and

purchasing costs remain under control.

The position combines operational purchasing with supplier development, cost analysis and

process improvement.

Key responsibilities:

Purchasing and supplier management

• Manage purchasing activities, including RFQs, purchase orders, order confirmations and delivery

follow-up.

• Identify, evaluate and qualify suppliers based on quality, cost, lead time and delivery performance.

• Negotiate prices, commercial terms and supplier agreements.

• Maintain supplier records, purchasing documentation and performance evaluations.

• Resolve supplier-related issues, including delivery delays, incorrect shipments and quality concerns.

Inventory and supply chain coordination

• Coordinate material requirements with engineering and production teams.

• Monitor stock levels, reorder points and material availability.

• Support purchasing planning for prototype development, testing and production activities.

• Identify supply chain risks and propose alternative suppliers or sourcing solutions.

Cost control and administration

• Maintain purchasing cost overviews, spending reports and supplier price comparisons.

• Monitor purchasing budgets and identify cost reduction opportunities.

• Coordinate invoice verification, purchase order matching and payment follow-up with finance.

• Support the development and implementation of purchasing procedures and supply chain processes.

Your profile:

Required qualifications

• Minimum 3 years of experience in purchasing, procurement or supply chain management.

• Experience working with suppliers, quotations, purchase orders and delivery coordination.

• Understanding of procurement cost control, supplier pricing and commercial negotiations.

• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

• Good analytical skills and proficiency in Excel or similar tools.

• Professional English communication skills, both written and spoken.

What we offer:

• A permanent, full-time position in a growing Danish technology company.

• Direct responsibility for purchasing and supplier management activities.

• The opportunity to establish and improve purchasing and supply chain processes.

• A workplace where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have a direct impact.

Application:

Send us your CV and a short introduction outlining your relevant experience.

Applications will be reviewed continuously, and interviews will be arranged with suitable

candidates.

Contact: Stine Alexander Westergaard saw@reblade.dk // Call me: +45 42411163

Workplace: Reblade ApS, Mørke, Denmark

Starting date: As soon as possible, by agreement.

jobs.occupation: Landbrugsmedhjælper
jobs.description:
Experienced Milker Wanted for a Modern Jersey Dairy Farm in North Jutland
Would you like to be part of a workplace built on respect, teamwork, and professionalism?

A well-managed dairy farm near Vrå (9760) is looking for an experienced employee for milking and other barn-related tasks. The farm has been operated with great passion and professional expertise for more than 42 years and has built a strong workplace culture where employees support one another, show mutual respect, and share responsibility for the daily work.

The farm is home to approximately 900 Jersey cows and operates with modern facilities and well-established routines that ensure high animal welfare standards and a positive working environment.

About the Position

We are looking for a new team member to strengthen the workforce and help maintain the high standards of daily operations.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Milking in a modern 60-point rotary milking parlor
• Bedding cubicles
• Washing and cleaning
• General barn duties
Three employees are involved in the milking operation, and tasks are rotated according to a schedule, providing variety throughout the working week.

Working Hours

Milking takes place:

• 03:00 - 08:00
• 15:00 - 19:30
Weekend work is included according to a rotating schedule.

Typically, you will:

• Work both morning and afternoon milking shifts 1-2 times per week
• Work only one shift per day during the remaining weekdays
There is a shared morning coffee break at 08:00, where colleagues meet and coordinate the day's tasks.

Who Are You?

We expect that you:

• Have experience milking dairy cows
• Speak and understand English
• Have an interest in dairy farming and agriculture
• Thrive in a structured work environment with routines and responsibilities
• Are reliable and flexible
• Are friendly and team-oriented
• Take initiative and approach challenges with a solutions-focused mindset
A driver's license is not required.

We Offer

• Permanent employment with the possibility of many years of service
• Competitive salary based on qualifications
• A stable and professionally managed workplace with 42 years of experience
• An international working environment with both Danish and foreign colleagues
• Supportive colleagues who help one another
• A workplace where respect, cooperation, and professionalism are a natural part of everyday life
The team currently consists of approximately 20 employees, including colleagues from Denmark, Ukraine, Kyrgyzstan, and Eritrea.

Please contact Tetiana if you want more information. The job is as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Bartender til The Moose Bar
jobs.description:
KAN DU STADIG SMILE KL. 05.30? [English Below]

Så er det måske dig, vi mangler bag baren på The Moose.

The Moose er ikke bare en bar. Det er et af Københavns mest ikoniske værtshuse – et sted, hvor stamgæster, turister, bartendere efter fyraften og københavnere, der absolut ikke er færdige med festen, mødes under samme tag.

Her er der højt tempo, kolde øl, lange nætter og masser af historier, som nok har bedst af at blive på The Moose.

Lige nu giver vi baren et friskt pust, og derfor leder vi efter nye bartendere, der har lyst til at blive en del af holdet.

Du behøver ikke kunne jonglere med flasker eller have fem års bartendererfaring. Vi lærer dig det, du skal kunne.

For os er det vigtigere, at du møder ind med god energi, kan tale med alle slags mennesker og har lyst til at skabe den stemning, der gør, at gæsterne bliver hængende lidt længere end planlagt.

VI LEDER EFTER DIG, DER...

• 
Er fyldt 18 år

• 
Møder på arbejde med godt humør og masser af energi

• 
Kan snakke med både stamgæsten i hjørnet og turistgruppen på deres første aften i København

• 
Trives, når baren er fyldt, musikken spiller, og tempoet er højt

• 
Kan bevare overblikket, når der pludselig står 15 mennesker og vil bestille på samme tid

• 
Er klar på nattevagter – også dem, der slutter, når resten af København er på vej efter morgenbrød

• 
Er en holdspiller, der både kan tage ansvar og have det sjovt imens

HOS THE MOOSE FÅR DU...

• 
Et deltidsjob, hvor to vagter sjældent ligner hinanden

• 
Et stærkt fællesskab med gode kollegaer og masser af sociale arrangementer

• 
Grundig oplæring – erfaring er fedt, men personlighed og attitude betyder mere

• 
Fleksible vagter, der kan passes ind ved siden af studie eller andet arbejde

• 
Personalerabat på vores barer i Indre København

• 
En arbejdsplads midt i Københavns natteliv, hvor der altid sker et eller andet

The Moose har været en del af det københavnske natteliv i mange år – og vi er langt fra færdige.

Vi bygger videre på alt det, der gør The Moose til The Moose: stemningen, gæsterne, de lange nætter og menneskerne bag baren.

Og nu mangler vi flere gode mennesker på holdet.

Så hvis et kontorjob lyder lidt kedeligere end en fyldt bar kl. 06.00, vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Send os en kort ansøgning og fortæl lidt om dig selv – og hvorfor du kunne se dig selv bag baren på The Moose.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

CAN YOU STILL SMILE AT 5:30 AM?

Then you might be exactly who we’re looking for at The Moose.

The Moose isn’t just another bar. It’s one of Copenhagen’s most iconic late-night pubs – a place where regulars, tourists, off-duty bartenders and people who simply aren’t ready to call it a night all end up under the same roof.

Expect busy nights, cold beers, long shifts and plenty of stories that are probably better left at The Moose.

Right now, we’re giving the bar a fresh boost, and we’re looking for new bartenders to join the team.

You don’t need to know how to juggle bottles or have five years of bartending experience. We’ll teach you what you need to know.

What matters more to us is that you show up with good energy, enjoy talking to all kinds of people and want to create the kind of atmosphere that makes guests stay for “just one more”.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO...

• 
Is 18 or older

• 
Brings good energy and a positive attitude to work

• 
Can chat with both the regular in the corner and the group of tourists on their first night in Copenhagen

• 
Enjoys working when the bar is packed, the music is playing and things move fast

• 
Can keep their cool when 15 people suddenly want to order at the same time

• 
Is ready for night shifts – including the ones that end when the rest of Copenhagen is heading out for breakfast

• 
Is a team player who can take responsibility without taking themselves too seriously

AT THE MOOSE, YOU’LL GET...

• 
A part-time job where no two shifts are quite the same

• 
A strong team with great colleagues and plenty of social events

• 
Proper training – experience is great, but personality and attitude matter more

• 
Flexible shifts that work alongside studies or another job

• 
Staff discounts at our bars in central Copenhagen

• 
A workplace right in the middle of Copenhagen nightlife, where something is always happening

The Moose has been part of Copenhagen’s nightlife for many years – and we’re nowhere near finished.

We’re building on everything that makes The Moose what it is: the atmosphere, the guests, the long nights and, most importantly, the people behind the bar.

And now we need a few more great people to join us.

So if an office job sounds slightly less exciting than a packed bar at 6:00 AM, we’d love to hear from you.

Send us a short application telling us a little about yourself – and why you could see yourself behind the bar at The Moose.

We can’t wait to hear from you.
